description: Build complete mobile-first frontend UI with purple/dark purple color scheme matching the user's design specs. Includes all 5 screens: Home (hero banner, Now Playing, Coming Soon), My Tickets (upcoming/passed/cancelled tabs), Food Order (menu with popular items), Account (profile, settings), and Cinemas. All vanilla HTML/CSS/JS with no external dependencies.
steps: Create movie-booking/public/index.html as the main SPA shell with: bottom navigation bar (Home, Cinemas, Food Order, My Tickets, Account icons), purple/dark purple accent colors (#6C3CE1 primary), white background, orange highlights for active states

Implement Home screen section: user avatar with 'Your City' location dropdown at top, hero banner/carousel area with movie poster (The Nun style), 'Now Playing' horizontal scrollable movie cards (Jawan, The Nun II, Hu ane Tu) with 'Book Now' buttons, 'Coming Soon' section with movie poster cards

Implement My Tickets screen section: tabs for Upcoming/Passed/Cancelled, filter pills (Movie, Food, Event), ticket cards showing movie poster thumbnail + title + date/time (e.g. 'Jawan - Dec 22,2023 . 17:30 - 20:38'), 'Remind me 30 minutes earlier' toggle per ticket, share and edit action buttons

Implement Food Order screen section: search icon at top, promotional banner carousel ('Best Movie Ticket Offers'), 'Most Popular' section with food item cards (Jumbo Popcorn $9.00, Coca Cola $5.00, French Fries $4.00 with quantity controls), 'New Beverages' section, 'View All' links

Implement Account screen section: user profile display (avatar, name 'Andrew Ainsely', email), QR code icon, menu items (Watchlist, Movie Interest, Payment Methods), General section (Personal Info, Notification, Security, Language with 'English (US)', Dark Mode toggle), About section (Help Center)
Implement Cinemas screen: list of nearby cinemas with address and available shows

Implement movie booking flow: tap 'Book Now' opens movie detail with showtime selection, seat map grid (rows A-J, seats 1-10), seat selection with color coding (available/selected/booked), price summary, booking confirmation form (name, phone)
Implement booking confirmation page showing ticket details with QR-style booking ID
Add smooth screen transitions, touch-friendly interactions (44px min tap targets), proper mobile viewport meta tags, and responsive design that caps at 480px width for mobile-only experience
Connect all screens to backend API: fetch movies from /api/movies, post bookings to /api/bookings, fetch food items from /api/food-orders, fetch user tickets from /api/bookings?phone=X
Add SVG icons for bottom navigation (home, cinema/film, food/utensils, ticket, user), use inline SVG for zero external dependencies
Implement local state management with JavaScript for screen navigation, cart state, and form data
acceptance_criteria: Opening http://localhost:3000 shows mobile-first UI with purple theme
Bottom navigation with 5 tabs (Home, Cinemas, Food Order, My Tickets, Account) all functional
Home screen shows hero banner, Now Playing scrollable cards with Book Now buttons, Coming Soon section
My Tickets screen shows tabs (Upcoming/Passed/Cancelled) and ticket cards with movie info and time
Food Order screen shows food items with prices ($9.00, $5.00, $4.00) and promotional banner
Account screen shows user profile 'Andrew Ainsely' with settings menu items and Dark Mode toggle
Booking flow works end-to-end: select movie -> select showtime -> select seats -> confirm -> see ticket in My Tickets
All UI is contained within max-width 480px mobile viewport
No external resources loaded - everything works offline/without internet
Color scheme uses purple/dark purple accents with white background and orange active highlights
verification: Start server with `unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd /projects/sandbox/Cluade/movie-booking && node server.js &`
curl http://localhost:3000/ should return valid HTML with purple theme CSS and bottom navigation
Verify the HTML contains all 5 navigation items: Home, Cinemas, Food Order, My Tickets, Account
Verify the HTML contains movie cards with 'Book Now' buttons
Verify the HTML contains food items with correct prices
Verify the HTML contains 'Andrew Ainsely' in account section
Test full booking flow via API: POST to /api/bookings and verify response
findings: Frontend SPA created successfully as a single index.html file (93KB). All 5 screens implemented: Home (hero banner, Now Playing, Coming Soon with movie cards from API), Cinemas (search, cinema list, View Shows with grouped showtimes), Food Order (promo banner, popular items, beverages, floating cart with add/remove controls), My Tickets (tabs, filter pills, ticket cards with share/edit actions, reminder toggle), Account (profile card with Andrew Ainsely, QR icon, menu sections for My Stuff/General/About, Dark Mode toggle). Full booking flow works end-to-end: movie detail > date selection > time slot > seat grid (10x10, color coded) > booking form > success with booking ID. All verified with 31/31 automated checks passing. No external dependencies - all CSS inline in style tag, all JS in script tag, all icons are inline SVGs. The curl utility has proxy issues in this environment but Node.js http client confirms all content is served correctly.
